user.title: AigoSmart account (unofficial integration)
user.description: Enter the email and password you use in the AigoSmart app.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: AigoSmart asked for an email verification code. A code was sent to {email} — enter it below. Codes expire after a few minutes; tick "Send a new code" and submit to get another one.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate AigoSmart
reauth_confirm.description: The AigoSmart cloud refused the stored login for {email}. This happens when the password was changed or the server asks for a new email verification code. Enter the new password, or leave it blank to retry with the current one (a verification code will be emailed if needed).

reconfigure.title: Change AigoSmart account
reconfigure.description: Update the email or password used to log in. Leave the password blank to keep the current one.

add_device.title: Add a device
add_device.description: Devices in pairing mode found via Bluetooth and WiFi. Put your device in pairing mode first (usually by holding its power button for 5 seconds).

wifi.title: WiFi credentials
wifi.description: Enter the WiFi network the new device should join. Provisioning happens over Bluetooth (works via ESPHome bluetooth proxy).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the AigoSmart cloud. Check your network and try again.
error.invalid_code: The verification code is wrong or expired. Check the email, or tick "Send a new code".
error.code_send_failed: The verification code email could not be requested. Tick "Send a new code" and submit to try again.
error.unknown_device: Selected device is no longer visible.
error.provision_failed: Provisioning failed. Make sure the device is still in pairing mode and near the Bluetooth adapter/proxy, then try again.

abort.not_loaded: The AigoSmart integration must be set up first.
abort.no_devices_found: No Aigostar devices in pairing mode were found. Hold the device's power button for ~5 seconds and try again.

init.title: Options
init.description: Home Assistant reads each device's state directly over your LAN (ALCS) when the device answers there, and uses the cloud otherwise. Commands still go through the cloud. The local_control section of a device's diagnostics shows whether local reads work for that device.

data.local_control: Read device state over the local network (experimental)

unsupported_device.title: {name} is not supported yet
unsupported_device.description:
AigoSmart found **{name}** ({product}, category `{category}`, productKey `{product_key}`), but this kind of device is not supported yet, so it has no entities in Home Assistant.

Select **Learn more** to open a device support request and attach the device's diagnostics (device page → ⋮ → Download diagnostics). This message disappears automatically once a version of the integration supports the device, or when the device is removed from your AigoSmart account.

sync_devices.name: Sync devices
sync_devices.description: Re-fetch the device list from the AigoSmart cloud and reload the integration.

discover_local.name: Discover local devices
discover_local.description: Run ALCS multicast discovery on the LAN and log discovered AigoSmart devices.

add_device.name: Add device
add_device.description: Start the guided Add-Device flow. Discovers Aigostar devices in pairing mode via Bluetooth (when the Home Assistant bluetooth integration is active) and via WiFi (devices reported by already-bound devices on the LAN).

discover_bluetooth.name: Discover Bluetooth devices
discover_bluetooth.description: Scan for Aigostar BLE devices (Breeze pairing service 0xFEB3) through the Home Assistant bluetooth integration and fire aigosmart_ble_found events.

set_properties.name: Set raw properties (advanced)
set_properties.description: Advanced / debugging: write TSL properties to a device exactly as given, bypassing the entities. Wrong names or values are rejected by the cloud or ignored by the device, and a wrong value can switch the device or change its settings. Admin only. Property names and ranges are in the device's diagnostics (tsl_model).

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The AigoSmart device to write to.

properties.name: Properties
properties.description: Property identifiers and values as a mapping, for example LightMode: 1.

set_feeding_plan.name: Set feeding schedule
set_feeding_plan.description: Replace a pet feeder's whole feeding schedule (adds or removes meals, like the app). Each meal runs every day. To change one existing meal, use its Meal entities instead.

meals.name: Meals
meals.description: List of meals: time (HH:MM), portions, and optionally enabled (default true).
